limits.note: over-length page charges past 14 pages (double-column); check the current IEEE author kit

notes: compsoc journal mode changes abstract/title layout - do not fight it
widths measured from IEEEtran (10pt journal compsoc): \columnwidth 252.945pt = 3.5in = 88.9mm, \textwidth 517.935pt = 182.0mm - and confirmed by the IEEE author center (resolution-and-size)
IEEE graphics guidance: figure type ~9-10pt at final size; raster >300dpi (color/grayscale), >600dpi (line art); vector preferred
double-column floats: \begin{figure*}[tb], never bare [t]; dblfloatfix + the preamble tuning keep them from stranding past the references
figures must survive B&W print; Okabe-Ito + redundant encoding covers this
IEEEtran class and bibliography style ship with TeX Live / MiKTeX
